name: Durmaz Google Sites Repository Bridge

dataPolicy.direction: read-only from public feed and sanitized registries to presentation layers

systems.macalyConvex: authoritative structured repository and authorization boundary
systems.github: sanitized public bridge source, integration manifests, version control, and deployment artifacts
systems.googleSites: external presentation layer for approved public content
systems.googleDrive: protected source/reference document storage with independent sharing controls
systems.sharePointInternal: planned protected operational workspace; provisioning pending SharePoint Online licensing
systems.sharePointExternal: planned curated client-facing communication experience; provisioning pending SharePoint Online licensing
systems.lovable: source platform for approved Durmaz Management, TaxSeasonSupport, and MobileNotaryHub public content plus internal portal concepts
systems.base44: source platform for TaxNavigator structured tax-operations models; internal-only by default
systems.replit: source platform for tax application prototypes; public reuse only after content classification and editorial review

publicationRule: Google Sites may display only content explicitly classified for public reuse. Internal/admin/client features are represented only as authenticated deep links or omitted entirely.
